source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-7

procedures.title: Battery: install
steps: Make sure nothing is lying in the carrier so the battery sits flat on its bottom.
Tighten the hold-down evenly until snug, not so tight that the case or cover distorts or cracks.
Check that the cables are in good shape and the clamps clean and tight, including the ground cable at the engine block or frame.
Check polarity so the battery is not reversed relative to the charging system.
Connect the grounded battery terminal last to avoid shorts.
Do not open cable terminals beyond the position shown; with the terminal fully open push it onto the post at least flush with or below the top, and never drive it on.
